title: Bronze Age sword discovered in an Italian lake is still sharp after 3,300 years
caption:
Archaeologists discovered a 3,300-year-old bronze sword in Italy's Lake Mezzano. The weapon, likely a ritual offering, remains remarkably well-preserved.

Source: Livescience - Bronze Age sword discovered in an Italian lake is still sharp after 3,300 years

https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/bronze-age-sword-discovered-in-an-italian-lake-is-still-sharp-after-3-300-years
